coverage.P06_AC01: TerminalTab, SessionSidebar, CommandComposer, CommandCard, StdinBar, and TranscriptViewer use Mantine chrome while preserving the native virtual transcript viewport, page/offset cache shape, and scroll owner.
coverage.P06_AC02: The P06 fixture asserts one Ctrl-C and one Ctrl-D RPC despite repeat keys, a policy-denied final state, stale transcript error feedback, and sandbox-scoped transcript records.
coverage.P06_AC03: The timeout field blocks submission when invalid. Selecting history filters the ledger but leaves the workspace execution target unchanged; the fixture covers narrow Drawer and desktop rail keyboard-visible flows.
coverage.P06_AC04: The large fixture has 10,000 lines plus one 10,000-character row. Tests assert fewer than 128 rendered virtual rows, visibility of the measured long row, no horizontal overflow, and a reachable tail.
coverage.P06_AC05: TranscriptPollProvider owns one 400 ms foreground / 2 s hidden timer, round-robins no more than four callbacks, and focus/visibility nudges preserve viewer identity. Collapse guards ensure hidden command cards do not poll.
coverage.P06_AC06: Dedicated nine-check browser suite, unit/build runs, full 134-check browser suite, Axe, screenshot triads, and visual review are recorded in this pack.
